purpose: Single pre-registered promotion decision for the opt-in ensemble.
history_scope: all laps for seasons < 2026 and 2026 rounds 1-18

decision.when: Once, after the final 2026 round is ingested (decide --final-round N).
decision.pool: 2026 test rounds 1-18 (saved rows above) + all usable prospective rounds 19..N
decision.otherwise: Planner stays default; candidate 7e8800ab93b81c68 is retired from opt-in.

interim_looks: Allowed for monitoring only (status command); each is logged; no decision may be taken from them.
no_changes: Candidate weights, ml/strategy code, the training-loop config and the history rows must match; any mismatch voids the check.
